in_sanskrit.name: धीम्सह
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धीम्स (dhīmsa) means sound or vibration. अह (aha) is a suffix that denotes existence, presence, or being. स (sa) is a suffix that denotes auspiciousness or excellence. Therefore, धीम्सह (dhīmsah) could mean a vibrant, radiant, or auspicious sound.

in_hindi.name: धीम्सह
in_hindi.long_meaning: धीमा (dhīmā) means sound or vibration in Hindi. शह (shah) is a suffix that denotes a ruler or a powerful being. Therefore, धीम्सह (dhīmsah) could mean a powerful or ruling sound.

in_tamil.name: தேஇம்சாஹ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: தேவ் (thev) is a Tamil word for god. இம்சம் (imsam) is a Tamil word for sound. அஹ் (ah) is a Tamil suffix that denotes existence or presence. Therefore, தேஇம்சாஹ் (tēimsāh) could mean the sound of God or a divine sound.

in_telugu.name: ధీమ్సహ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధీమ్ (dhīm) is a Telugu word for sound or vibration. శహ్ (shah) is a Telugu suffix that denotes a ruler or a powerful being. Therefore, ధీమ్సహ్ (dhīmsah) could mean a powerful or ruling sound.

in_marathi.name: Dheemsah
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheemsah हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheemsah is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dheema’ meaning ‘message’ and ‘sa’ meaning ‘god’. The name suggests receiving and acting upon divine guidance.
